shouldersurfing.configuration.camera.cam: x-axis multiplier for camera drag. Set to 0 to disable.
y-axis multiplier for camera drag. Set to 0 to disable.
z-axis multiplier for camera drag. Set to 0 to disable.
The maximum x-axis angle in degrees. Set to 0 to disable.
The maximum z-axis angle in degrees. Set to 0 to disable.
The velocity of the player in blocks per second, where the maximum camera x-axis sway is applied.
The velocity of the player in blocks per second, where the maximum camera z-axis sway is applied.
shouldersurfing.configuration.camera.fov: The camera FOV when in shoulder surfing perspective. Depends on config option 'FOV override enabled'.
Whether to apply the FOV override when in shoulder surfing perspective.
shouldersurfing.configuration.camera.non: The list of blocks that do not collide with the camera. Must be transparent blocks or blocks that do not take up a full block. This config option supports regular expressions. Example: 'minecraft:.*leaves' matches 'minecraft:oak_leaves' and 'minecraft:spruce_leaves'.
shouldersurfing.configuration.camera.off: Whether to ignore block pillars, such as tree trunks, when calculating camera offsets. This improves overall immersion at the cost of block targeting accessibility.
A list of x-offset presets that can be toggled via the 'Toggle X-Offset Presets' keybind. §cWARNING: Duplicate entries can result in undefined behavior!§r
A list of y-offset presets that can be toggled via the 'Toggle Y-Offset Presets' keybind. §cWARNING: Duplicate entries can result in undefined behavior!§r
A list of z-offset presets that can be toggled via the 'Toggle Z-Offset Presets' keybind. §cWARNING: Duplicate entries can result in undefined behavior!§r
shouldersurfing.configuration.camera.tur: Whether to turn the camera with the player when camera is decoupled.
The delay in ticks after which the camera will turn with the player.
shouldersurfing.configuration.camera.vie: Whether to apply view bobbing in shoulder surfing perspective. Set to INHERIT to inherit vanilla setting.
shouldersurfing.configuration.gui.maps.m: The insets in scaled pixels from the bottom of the screen.
The inset in scaled pixels from the left of the screen.
The inset in scaled pixels from the right of the screen.
The inset in scaled pixels from the top of the screen.
The directional anchor to use for map item overlay rendering.
Whether to render map previews in the hud when a map item is held.
The scale to use for map item overlay rendering.
shouldersurfing.configuration.integratio: Item properties of an item, that when equipped in a curios slot, trigger the dynamic crosshair in adaptive mode. Example: 'necklace@charged'

Items that when equipped in a curios slot, trigger the dynamic crosshair in adaptive mode. This config option supports regular expressions. The curios slot must be specified before the expression and is separated by an '@' character. Example: 'ring@angelring:.*_ring' matches 'angelring:diamond_ring' and 'angelring:angel_ring' when equipped in the 'ring' slot.
Whether to allow target lock-on when camera is decoupled.
shouldersurfing.configuration.object_pic: The list of invisible entities to ignore while picking. This config option supports regular expressions. Example: 'minecraft:oak_.*' matches 'minecraft:oak_boat' and 'minecraft:oak_chest_boat'.
shouldersurfing.configuration.offset_thr: Temporary first person offset threshold settings.
shouldersurfing.configuration.perspectiv: The additional time in ticks the perspective will stay in temporary first person after leaving a constrained space.
The time in ticks the temporary first will be on cooldown before it can be entered again.
Whether to switch to first person perspective temporarily when entering areas with limited height. For example, small buildings or caves.
The minium time in ticks the temporary first will be active when entering a constrained space.
The x-axis camera offset threshold. When the x-axis camera offset falls below the configured threshold, the perspective will switch to temporary first person.
The y-axis camera offset threshold. When the y-axis camera offset falls below the configured threshold, the perspective will switch to temporary first person.
The z-axis camera offset threshold. When the z-axis camera offset falls below the configured threshold, the perspective will switch to temporary first person.
shouldersurfing.configuration.player.tra: Whether to turn the player model transparent when aiming. This config option only applies when adjust player transparency is enabled.
Whether to turn the player model transparent when climbing. This config option only applies when adjust player transparency is enabled.
shouldersurfing.configuration.player.tur: Whether the x-rot of the player turns such that it is always facing the camera. This config option only applies when camera is decoupled and player x-rot turning with camera is enabled.
The speed multiplier at which the player rotation converges to the movement direction of the player.
shouldersurfing.configuration.temporary_: Temporary first person in constrained spaces
Temporary first person in constrained spaces settings.
